title: GovernedDeliveryEnvelope v1
description: One transport wrapper for exactly five payload kinds. The DMX-GOV-WORKFLOW-OPT-001 census found 39 semantic message classes; they share producer, consumer, binding, idempotency, evidence-reference and retention mechanics, so they are carried by five kinds rather than 39 standalone schemas. Transport never adds authority: authority_effect defaults to NONE and mutation_authorized is structurally false.

kind.description: Exactly five kinds. A sixth kind is a contract change, not an extension point.

event_type.description: The census message class carried, e.g. AuditRequest. Semantic identity lives here; transport identity lives in kind.

consumer.description: Declared consumer. An unknown consumer policy fails closed at the reducer.

subject_ref.description: The exact subject this message is about. Cross-project subject or evidence mismatch is denied.

idempotency_key.description: Duplicate key with an identical payload is an accepted duplicate; duplicate key with a different payload is denied.

mutation_authorized.description: Structurally false. A message cannot carry mutation permission.
